about: Test vectors for the portable verification extension 0.3.0, written by generate_vectors.py from published inputs. Records R0 to R2 and R4, the chain and the test keys are those of the anchoring and signatures vectors; R3 and D2 are made from R2. An entry's signature is the signatures 0.2.0 organisation seal of kind record over the entry's decision_id and its seal_hash or derived_digest; r0 and r2 are byte for byte the signatures vectors' seal_record_r0 and seal_record_r2. Test keys only, derived from their published seed texts: never real keys. Documents are read as JSON with no whitespace, in UTF-8, by the convention of these cases.

chain.about: link(i) = SHA-256(link(i-1) || digest(i)), with 32 zero bytes before the first entry; digest(i) is the entry's seal_hash, or D2's derived_digest for the fourth entry. L0 to L2 are the anchoring vectors' links.

covered_representation.canonicalisation: members sorted by name, no whitespace
